title: Protein Carbonyl Assay Protocol
author: Peter Havel
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.63hhgj6

steps.title: Prepare Sample and Control Tubes
steps.instruction: Transfer 200 µl of sample into two 2 ml plastic tubes, designating one as the sample tube (S#) and the other as the control tube (C#).

steps.title: Add Reagents
steps.instruction: Add the specified reagents to the respective tubes.

substeps.instruction: Add 800 µl of DNPH to the sample tube (S#).
Add 800 µl of 2.5 M HCl to the control tube (C#).

steps.title: Incubate Tubes
steps.instruction: Incubate both tubes (S# & C#) in the dark at room temperature for one hour, vortexing each tube briefly every 15 minutes.

steps.title: Precipitate Proteins
steps.instruction: Add 1 ml of 20% TCA to each tube and vortex, then incubate on ice for five minutes.

steps.title: First Centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge tubes at 10,000 xg for 10 minutes at 4ºC in a microcentrifuge.

steps.title: First Wash
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 1 ml of 10% TCA, then let sit on ice for five minutes.

steps.title: Second Centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge tubes at 10,000 xg for 10 minutes at 4ºC in a microcentrifuge.

steps.title: Organic Solvent Wash
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant and wash the pellet using a (1:1) Ethanol/Ethyl Acetate mixture.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 1 ml of (1:1) Ethanol/Ethyl Acetate mixture.
Manually suspend pellet with spatula and vortex thoroughly.
Centrifuge tubes at 10,000 xg for 10 minutes at 4ºC in a microcentrifuge.

steps.title: Repeat Organic Wash
steps.instruction: Repeat the organic solvent wash process (resuspension, vortexing, and centrifugation) two more times.

steps.title: Resuspend Protein Pellets
steps.instruction: Resuspend the protein pellets in 500 µl of guanidine hydrochloride by vortexing.

steps.title: Final Debris Removal
steps.instruction: Centrifuge tubes at 10,000 xg for 10 minutes at 4ºC in a microcentrifuge to remove any remaining debris.

steps.title: Load 96-Well Plate
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant from the tubes to a 96-well plate.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 220 µl of supernatant from the sample (S#) tube to two wells.
Transfer 220 µl of supernatant from the control (C#) tube to two wells.

steps.title: Measure Absorbance
steps.instruction: Measure the absorbance of the wells at a wavelength between 360-385 nm using a plate reader.

steps.title: Calculate Carbonyl Concentration
steps.instruction: Determine the concentration of carbonyls using the measured absorbance values.

substeps.instruction: Calculate the average absorbance of each sample and control.
Subtract the average absorbance of the controls from the average absorbance of the samples to find the Corrected Absorbance (CA).
Calculate concentration using the extinction coefficient for dinitrophenylhydrazine at 370 nm (22,000 M-1 cm-1 or 0.022 µM-1 cm-1), adjusted for the pathlength of the solution in the well.
